title: WEDM Benchmark Tolerance Bands — Production-Gate Thresholds
note: v2 (tightened) replaces v1 (±30/±20/±70/±70) after MS3 validated that the pipeline is stable enough to hold production-grade bands. Values below are absolute-percentage tolerances — |shop-published|/published < band → 'acceptable'.

area_cutting_rate_pct.applies_to: shop area rate (mm²/min) vs published area rate for ISO group
area_cutting_rate_pct.rationale: ±20% captures real shop variance from wire diameter choice (brass vs coated), flushing pressure, and machine wear. ±30% was too permissive — admits programs that leave 25% productivity on the table.

kerf_width_pct.rationale: Kerf is a pure geometric sum; variance should come only from spark gap drift. ±15% matches operator measurement repeatability.

surface_finish_ra_pct.applies_to: predicted Ra vs measured Ra after finishing passes
surface_finish_ra_pct.rationale: Ra prediction is now Bayesian-calibrated per-material (see WEDMFeedbackCalibrationEngine k_ra posterior). ±30% is the 95% CI of the calibrated posterior after 50+ programs.

d2_rough_speed_pct.applies_to: D2 tool steel rough cutting speed (linear mm/min) vs published for thickness
d2_rough_speed_pct.rationale: D2 is the most-run material at JM Die (>40% of programs). ±25% is tight enough to flag real process drift but loose enough not to false-alarm on 6 mm vs 25 mm thickness variance.

offset_cascade_pct.applies_to: total offset cascade range (rough − final skim) vs wire_diameter × 0.35
offset_cascade_pct.rationale: Previously 30% (line 197 of WEDMCalibrationReportEngine). Tightened with the surface-finish band.

rough_speed_pct_default.applies_to: Rough cut speed (non-D2 materials) vs published for ISO group
rough_speed_pct_default.rationale: Unchanged — was already at the ±20% target. Kept here for single-source-of-truth.
